intro: Two decisions span the modules: one policy for background jobs and one rule for reading lists.

sections.title: One policy for background jobs
sections.context: Each queue sets its own ids, retries and clean-up.
sections.decision: One shared job policy, applied by a small helper.
sections.consequences: Fewer surprises; every queue must be touched once.

sections.title: Every list read is bounded
sections.context: Several reads load a whole workspace at once.
sections.decision: A paging helper, with a lint rule that flags reads without it.
sections.consequences: Reads become predictable; callers must handle pages.
